brief.headline: Binance restores backing for 90% of hacked assets
brief.detail: Binance says it has restored backing for 90% of assets affected by its $6.3 billion hack and plans to resume withdrawals, subject to security checks.

brief.headline: Nasdaq faces $2 trillion wipeout as AI fears deepen
brief.detail: Reuters reports the Nasdaq faces a $2 trillion wipeout in October as fears over AI spending deepen.

brief.headline: Fitch downgrades France's outlook after economic contraction
brief.detail: The unscheduled move came hours after data showed an unexpected contraction in third-quarter economic output in France.

brief.headline: Reddit shares plunge 30% after weak outlook
brief.detail: Reddit shares sank on Friday after weak Q4 sales guidance, and the company said it will test requiring users to log in to see content.

brief.headline: Anthropic files for potential record-breaking IPO
brief.detail: Anthropic has filed for a potential record-breaking initial public offering, according to the report.
